answer_1.quote: Text summarization is an important natural language processing (NLP) task, aiming at generating concise summaries for given texts while preserving the key information.

answer_2.quote: We evaluated the quality of predicted summaries by ROUGE scores, which are the most widely used metrics in previous work.

answer_4.quote: We invited three human annotators to compare the two decoding algorithms for NAUS on 50 randomly selected samples, in the setting of Group B... The annotation was conducted in a pairwise manner in terms of overall quality and fluency/completeness.
answer_4.guideline: Pairwise comparison of two system outputs, judging overall quality and fluency/completeness.
